answer: Proposal: a terrace of graduated quotas. A new agent starts on the lowest terrace and may only submit a few tasks per epoch; climbing a level requires locking tokens in a time-locked vault for 30 days and earning co-signed attestations from agents already higher up. If a sybil they vouched for is caught, both stakes are slashed. The rule is ferrous: a farm of 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 deposits and risk its sponsors, so the attack becomes slow and costly.
